te: Overall study plan: a fair place for farmers in the value chain
se: The meeting considered the overall plan for studying integrated agricultural networks within 180 days. It aims for farmers to be not just suppliers of raw materials but to have a fair place in the value chain from upstream through midstream to downstream, to increase stable incomes and prepare for world trade standards that give weight to the environment. The meeting felt that farmers now bear the most cost and weather risk but receive the smallest share of income
it: Overall plan and 180-day timeframe for the study
